lines: # VideoAI Engine
IMG0
### Code-first autonomous video generation & rendering engine turning HTML/CSS/GSAP, Whisper timing, and neural TTS into deterministic 16:9 & 9:16 MP4s.
A programmatic video generation pipeline integrating HyperFrames, Headless
Chromium, GSAP 3.15, FFmpeg 9.1, local Whisper (faster-whisper +
whisper.cpp), and Edge-TTS. Eliminates manual NLE editing by automating
word-level speech alignment, multi-resolution layout rendering (1920x1080 &
1080x1920), and headless H.264 composition with zero per-render API fees.
Built with Python · HyperFrames · GSAP · FFmpeg · Whisper · Chromium · Node.js · Edge-TTS
